description: This file contains utility functions for parsing command-line arguments and environment variables, specifically geared toward handling flags for number, string, and boolean options, as well as environment variables. It provides abstractions for consuming and applying command-line args and environment variables, facilitating configurable scripts.

methods.name: readEnvNumber
methods.description: Reads a numeric environment variable by name and returns its float value, or null if unset or invalid.

methods.name: consumeStringFlag
methods.description: Checks if a command-line argument at a specific index matches a flag and returns its associated string value if present.

methods.name: consumeStringListFlag
methods.description: Checks for a string list flag and returns its value if present.

methods.name: consumeIntFlag
methods.description: Parses an integer flag value from command-line arguments with optional bounds checking.

methods.name: consumeFloatFlag
methods.description: Parses a float flag value from command-line arguments with optional bounds checking and inclusion options.

methods.name: stringFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer for string flags and maps them to object keys.

methods.name: stringListFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer that appends string values to a list in an object.

methods.name: intFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer for integer flags with optional validation.

methods.name: floatFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer for float flags with validation options.

methods.name: booleanFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer for boolean flags, setting a key to true or specified value.

methods.name: parseFlagArgs
methods.description: Main function to parse an array of command-line arguments according to specified flag definitions, applying them to a target arguments object; supports options for unknown arguments and double dash handling.
